name: Advanced Spoiler
author: Cheon, YoungMin

sections.description:
New version of Ajax Spoiler plugin renamed to ‘Advanced Spoiler’.

Show or hide contents(text, image etc.) with animated effects wrapped by spoiler markup tag([spoiler][/spoiler]).

  • Animate effects: appear, blind, slide, apblind(appear + blind), phase, simple(no animate)
  • Supports TinyMCE button and quicktags button
  • Provides option page for default effect, show text, hide text, animate speed, nested spoilers.
  • Supports ‘Simple Mode’: no aniated effects and just simple javascript.

Included Translations

  • Korean translation by me 😉
  • Russian translation by FatCow – Thanks!
  • Ukraine translation by Kosiv in Ukraine – Thanks!
  • Spanish translation by Juanito – Thanks!

Usage

Enclose any paragraphs or passages with [spoiler] and [/spoiler]

e.g.

  • simple: [spoiler] spoiler content... [/spoiler]
  • options: [spoiler effect="blind" show="Show me" hide="Hide me"] spoiler content... [/spoiler]
sections.installation:
1. Upload advanced-spoiler folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.changelog:
2.03

  • Security: fixed stored XSS through the show/hide shortcode attributes (Simple mode inline onclick, and HTML injection when the toggle label changes in jQuery mode).
  • Removed the inline onclick handler and inline script. Simple mode now loads js/simple-spoiler.js, which binds the toggle with addEventListener.
  • Show/hide labels are passed in data-show/data-hide attributes and written as plain text, never as HTML.
  • Escaped the feed link and the option page preview.
  • PHP 7/8 compatibility: removed =& new and create_function(), and fixed undefined index notices on the option page.
  • Removed the unused MooTools and Prototype scripts; jQuery is the only animated mode.
